facts: UK finance recruiting runs roughly a year ahead of the internship, and rolling. Roles close when full, not on the advertised deadline — week one and week eight are different outcomes at the same firm.
The US cycle runs six to nine months ahead of the UK one. Summer 2027 US applications opened Jan–Mar 2026 and seats were largely gone by June 2026.
